keyPhrases.text: exhilarating to see 31 actors on stage
they do a lot of borrowing
Butterworth indulges in Tracy Letts' approach

reasoning: Mixed review with both significant praise and criticism. Acknowledges the success of keeping audience attention for 3+ hours and praises the third act, but criticizes derivative elements and overly sentimental family portrayal. The tone suggests respect for the ambition while noting execution flaws.
